_comment: Per-tree offset between a migration directory's timestamp prefix and the real
commit date. Enforced by scripts/check-migration-timestamps.mjs on every PR.
apps/api carries yearOffset 2 because its names ratcheted +730 days ahead of
real time between 2026-07-19 and 2026-09-05 and cannot be renamed: many of
these migrations are applied to production and to the shared local fixture DB,
and renaming an applied migration causes Prisma drift errors. Pinning the
offset FREEZES the drift at exactly two years instead of letting it keep
growing. It does not fix it. The offset is retired to 0 at the next migration
baseline/squash, when the directory names can be rewritten safely.
Raising a yearOffset is a deliberate, reviewable change. If you find yourself
wanting to raise one, that is the drift trying to happen again.
